author: Justin Carter
title: Jon Watts Left ‘Fantastic Four’ to Get His Groove Back
description: In another timeline, Watts would've brought the Fantastic Four back after just tying off Spider-Man's first saga.
content: Before Matt Shakman took over directing duties for the MCU’s first Fantastic Four movie, Jon Watts was in charge. The director of the Spider-Man: Home trilogy dropped out in 2022, and his reasons for… [+1588 chars]
